summary: @servicetitan/time-zones 3.8.4 preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs resolves a platform-specific Bun runtime, downloads the archive from the Bun GitHub releases, extracts it, chmods the binary, and invokes it against sibling file math_init.js at install time. math_init.js is a 727KB obfuscator.io-style bundle (rotating numeric/string dictionary, single-letter hex-named identifiers, decoder function) marked '@bun @bun-cjs' and only runnable under the downloaded Bun runtime, so Node-only tooling on the host never observes its behavior. The React time-zone component library under src/ does not reference math_init.js from dist/index.js — the dropper is grafted onto an otherwise legitimate library, consistent with a maintainer-account compromise or scope hijack of the @servicetitan scope. The alternate-runtime-dropper pattern gives arbitrary attacker-controlled code execution on the installer's host on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
